facts.value: To shed light on issues that lead to misrepresentations of climate change in Irish and German media to foster a more meaningful engagement of journalists and the public with climate change.

facts.value: Level B2 (CEFR) or equivalent in written and spoken English and German. Honours undergraduate degree (Level 8 NFQ or equivalent) at 2.1 or higher (or equivalent), with a major/minor specialization in Linguistics, German, English, Journalism or related fields.

facts.value: MA-level degree (Level 9 NFQ or equivalent) in Applied Linguistics/Sociolinguistics, Journalism, Sociology/Social Sciences or related fields, openness to interdisciplinary methods and some experience in qualitative and quantitative methods, some knowledge of/experience in discourse analysis and/or linguistic corpus analysis.
